notes.title: Nudist Beach Survival Simulator Remastered is on the way!
notes.content:
Nudist Beach Survival Simulator will be re-created on Unreal Engine 4! Changing the engine is primarily to fix all minor bugs in the game and add new content.

By default, the new version of the game will be included:

 New gameplay modes
 More settings 
 Full controller support
 New Steam achievements
 Steam Cloud support


Expected premiere date: fourth quarter 2020

Stay tuned!
